0.reason: Duplicated loader in a prototype measurement script; not product code.

1.reason: Reverting book to the 16-cell tile changes the booked bytes, and the byte pins on both measured CPU families catch it. The constant test pins the intended value. A compiled-structure guard is not worth another round.

findings.text: read_processes re-implements the per-process receipt loader that scripts/prototypes/bank_booking_primal_buckets/report.py:42-88 already owns inline, reading the same capture.json and attribution.json pair and repeating the same compilation-cache-hit assertion, so a change to the receipt layout must now be made in both files; the owner should be extracted and called rather than duplicated.

the added guard asserts only that the module constant equals 32 and never asserts that book uses it, so reinstating the original formulation at nova/equilibrium/current.py:481 (batch_width = min(quadrature.cut_batch_width, cells), default 16) leaves _SCALAR_CUT_BATCH_WIDTH at 32 and this test green; only the host byte pins would redden, and only on the two pinned CPU families.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 6 production call sites in nova/equilibrium/support_read.py (414, 536, 560, 564, 1097, 1135); no production caller of current.book or current.book_tangent_channels exists outside that module.
item_verdicts.diff: read all 13 commits against 9ab6ba60 commit by commit; e79d54fd restores the 32-cell primal tile and adds the prior timing arm to scripts/prototypes/bank_booking_primal_buckets/device.py:13-40, 523346cd factors _SCALAR_CUT_BATCH_WIDTH at nova/equilibrium/current.py:69 and adds cpu_contract.py/.sh and the tile guard, e38cf69c re-pins the Broadwell tuple at tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:24-30, 1d3b4f182 touches only the evidence fragment, and the tradeoff.py commits assemble the attribution and three-arm tables.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is per-field moment parity at 1e-14, an unchanged-or-repinned pin with its difference table, paired suites with no added failures, and one H200 allocation tabling residual device ms and launches, per-process reads, whole-solve wall and wall per read against the pair_gaps precision budgets; the fragment records 1.708597e-16 relative on the five moment references, a three-field pin table backed by cpu-contract/broadwell-pins.log, baseline-suite.log 1 failure to cpu-contract/sirius-suite.log 0 failures, and the three-arm 1/16-slice tables with every precision maximum under its limit.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to give current.book the same separate-population, shared-helper structure as book_tangent_channels without a vmap conditional and without the booking regression; nova/equilibrium/current.py:479-487 buckets the conic and normal populations and :481 now takes the shared 32-cell tile at :69, so the delta removes the 16-cell regression the prior review blocked on and keeps the shared structure.

justifications.durability: the added guard tests/test_book_primal_buckets.py:37 reddens under the recorded tile mutation (cpu-contract/negative-tile-test_book_primal_buckets.log, EXIT=1, assert 16 == 32) but it pins the constant rather than its use, so the original formulation at nova/equilibrium/current.py:481 could return with the guard still green.
